Faceless studio · research, 5 September 2026

How Type Moves in 2026

Six uploads from July to September this year, framed at twenty frames a second wherever their type moves. The question was how the best channels make text feel alive. The answer was not what our first keyword layer assumed.

Not one of the six pops a word with a scale bounce. Type in 2026 reveals information in time with the voice: it types, un-blurs word by word, counts up, swaps in place, and holds.

What was measured

Channel · uploadViewsWhat its type does, in frames
fern · The Death of Educational Content on YouTube · 2 Sep6.3MTypewriter 45–60 ms a character, no cursor. Spoken sentences un-blur word by word, 0.15–0.2 s apart. Giant caps present on the cut. A light flash into the cut.
Half as Interesting · Why Almost Every Airline Has Sued This One Website · 5 Aug1.7MNumbers count up in 0.25–0.35 s with digits resolving left to right, tracked onto a moving document. An equation accretes term by term over 6 s while the document blurs behind it. Labels swap in one frame with a colour change.
Johnny Harris · The REAL reason the US can’t beat Iran · 16 Jul5.6MTypewriter 30–40 ms a character on a parchment card, each line on its spoken beat, older lines scroll up. One word holds while five map cuts strobe behind it. A light leak into the card.
neo · How the U.S. Doomsday Plane Works · 13 Jul1.7MA pill label fades in over 0.3 s, holds 10 s, and is renamed by a 0.2 s cross-dissolve in the same seat.
Jake Tran · Everything Wrong With The Night Epstein “Died” · 4 Sep32kYellow caps type at 36–40 ms a character with a block cursor, and keep typing straight across a cut. A red marker writes itself on.
Alex Hormozi · How I Would Build a Service Business in 2026 · 29 Aug850kThe channel that made caption pops famous now hard-cuts full phrases with no per-word motion. Its stat card is a white ground, a brush stroke, the figure landing in 0.1 s, an underline drawing 0.6 s later.

Method: tools/study_type.py scans a video at one frame a second to find the type, then bursts a two-second window at twenty frames a second so the entrance can be counted frame by frame. Sheets are in study/hyper. Timings below are read from those sheets, not from tutorials.

Rules the frames agree on

  • Entrance is a reveal, not a bounce. Blur-in, typing, counting, or a hard landing on the word. No overshoot in any of the six.
  • Everything lands on the spoken word. Each item in a list arrives on its own word; a sentence arrives word by word on the voice.
  • Holds are long. 1.5 s minimum, 13 s at the top (Harris). Type leaves on the cut, never on its own.
  • Numbers roll. 0.25 to 0.4 s of digits resolving, left to right, then stillness.
  • Big type owns the frame. The footage blurs and darkens behind it, or the type sits on a flat ground.
  • Flashes go in, never out. A light leak or white frame introduces a type card; nothing flashes when it leaves.
  • Mixed case is the default. Caps are for one giant word or a small label. The 2019 yellow-caps-everywhere look is gone from every channel measured.

What was built today

The keyword template was rewritten on these numbers. The first version, which popped with a 0.28 s overshoot, is kept as keyword_run_v1_pop.html for comparison.

Mark in the scriptWhat the viewer seesMeasured source
*word*Blur-in over 0.22 s, no bounce, holds to the cutfern
any figure, money, month-yearCounts up over 0.42 s, digits resolving left to right; bare years land wholeHalf as Interesting
*>typed line*Typewriter, 45 ms a character, block cursor blinks out; lines accrete down a left column; footage blurs behindfern, Harris, Tran
*^spoken line*Each word un-blurs on its own timing from the alignerfern
*!Giant line*Hard-on in 0.1 s with a warm flash, slow drift while it holds; footage blurs and darkens behindHarris, fern, HAI
*=swap*Cross-dissolves in place over 0.2 s in the accent colour, replacing the item before itneo, HAI
*~old~ new*The old term struck through 0.25 s after landing, the correction beside ittype that turns
*@Dated slug*Small stamp top-left over the opening sceneSearch Party

The compositor gained a plate: when a shot carries a giant line or typed lines, its footage is blurred and darkened from the first such item to the cut, and the change is stamped into the segment cache so it re-renders.

Where type sits

A second pass, after the owner watched the first masters on a phone: a line that runs edge to edge is tracked, not read. Frames from the same references and from ours were measured for how much of the width the type covers.

FrameWidth covered
neo · label pill25%
Johnny Harris · SUPERPOWER / treaty card40% / 42%
Half as Interesting · 10,000,000 monthly users / equation55% / 46%
fern · They’re dead wrong58%
fern · ENOUGH IS ENOUGH, on a flat white ground89%
ours, first masters · giant lines88% and 94%
ours, first masters · spoken lines61% and 62%

The rule now in the template: every keyword run lives in a zone 40% of the frame wide, centred, or seated left or right when a card holds the other side. Long items shrink; giant and spoken lines wrap into a stacked block of at most three rows; nothing enters the outer 5%. Subtitle standards allow 68% of the width for captions because captions are read continuously. Keywords are read at a glance, so the zone is tighter.

The same pass found a clip flashing for 0.6 s between a chapter dip and its card, type leaving in the pause before a cut because overlays were timed to the spoken words rather than the segment, and anchor walls that had overridden the shot floors. All three are fixed at the source and a check, tools/qa_master.py, now measures every master for them before it is delivered.

Still to build

  • A word that outlasts its shot (Harris’s POWER over five cuts). The planner cuts overlays with the shot; this needs a run that spans shots.
  • Type tracked onto a moving prop (HAI’s figure riding the document). Needs a motion track; the document scenes could carry it since we control that camera.
  • A sound per reveal: a soft tick on each typed character and a low thud under a giant line. Every channel measured has one; ours is silent.
  • The two rebuilds are still waiting on the voice quota. The first real frames of this layer arrive with them.
